description: This file defines the LoanDisbursement class and related functions for managing loan disbursements, including validation, accounting entries, and security valuation within the ERPNext loan management module.

classes.name: LoanDisbursement
classes.description: A controller class for handling loan disbursement processes, including validation, status updates, and general ledger entries.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks before processing disbursement.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when a loan disbursement is submitted.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when a disbursement is canceled.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets default values for disbursement fields if they are not provided.

methods.name: validate_disbursal_amount
methods.description: Checks that the disbursed amount does not exceed the permissible amount.

methods.name: set_status_and_amounts
methods.description: Updates the disbursement status and related loan fields based on cancel or submit action.

methods.name: get_values_on_cancel
methods.description: Calculates disbursal values when a disbursement is canceled.

methods.name: get_values_on_submit
methods.description: Calculates disbursal values when a disbursement is submitted.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates general ledger entries for the disbursement transaction.
